entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, so about 36 days ago. To make sure I document this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken. Honestly, I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. Can I return it or not?
I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for that item. Please hold one moment.
Thanks for waiting. Okay, I've checked our policy and you're all set. Our standard return window is 10 days, so at 36 days, you're unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Great. So you'll email me a shipping label?

Yes, I've just processed the return authorization. You should receive an email with a prepaid return label and instructions within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
